name: io.github.Esoteric918/countylayer
title: CountyLayer
description: MCP server for querying Tulsa County, Oklahoma property and parcel data for AI agents.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your CountyLayer API key>. Subscribe at https://countylayer.com/#pricing to get one - delivered by email after checkout.

tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Look up property records by street address. Matches partial addresses.

tools.name: lookup_owner
tools.description: Look up all properties owned by a given name. Matches partial names.

tools.name: get_property_details
tools.description: Get the full record for a single property by its account number.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.dataCoverage: Tulsa County, Oklahoma parcel records, ~250,000 parcels, sourced from INCOG's public ArcGIS feed.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.pricing: Manual: $29/month, 1,000 queries/month. Agent: $99/month, 10,000 queries/month. Full pricing at https://countylayer.com/#pricing.
